findings.summary: WARN language×archetype advisory must NOT change exit code (rc stays 0).
Coherence gate must run BEFORE generateAndFinalize so nothing is written to disk on CRITICAL abort.
--dry-run returns before the gate (init.ts:214); a dry-run of an incoherent cell must preview without abort, matching L3-gate ordering.
language 'unknown'/'multi' and undefined archetype must be treated as OK (no false WARN).
doctor must surface language×archetype as WARN only, never FAIL (must not trip gate exit code).
collaborationMode optional on ProjectConfig — resolve via resolveCollaborationMode before validateCollaborationCoherence.
